summary.headline: RYUK-IL C&S. largest shareholder changes to Heo Jeong-hye et al. via inheritance; 31.25% stake
summary.what_happened: RYUK-IL C&S., Ltd. disclosed a change of its largest shareholder following the death of former largest shareholder Gu Ja-ok. The 5,521,401 shares previously held by the deceased were divided among the spouse and two children under an inheritance property division agreement, with Heo Jeong-hye named as the new largest shareholder group holding 31.25%. The change date and confirmation date (name transfer completion) are both Nov 27, 2026, and this is a corrective filing to an earlier Nov 19, 2026 disclosure.

summary.why_it_matters: A change of largest shareholder caused by inheritance usually means control of the listed company's ownership passes to the heirs of the deceased shareholder, and the filing typically signals that further holding reports may follow once inheritance procedures are complete. Shareholders in Korea often watch such filings for later disclosures on the heirs' stakes and any changes in management.
